stories.title: Nawaz hails his govt’s ‘serious’ work on AJK development as PML-N charts 100-day plan
stories.brief: PML-N supremo Nawaz Sharif hailed the “serious” work done by his government for the development of Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK) during a meeting with the region’s President Muhammad Najeeb Naqi Khan and Prime Minister Syed Iftikhar Ali Gillani on Wednesday.

stories.title: Pakistan conducts successful launch of Fatah-3 supersonic cruise missile: ISPR
stories.brief: The Pakistan Army on Wednesday successfully launched the Fatah-3 supersonic cruise missile, according to the military’s media wing. It added that the missile would “significantly enhance the operational flexibility and strike range of the Pakistan Army’s Rocket Force Command, further strengthening the country’s overall conventional deterrence and defence posture”.

stories.title: Military successfully tests launch of Fatah-3 supersonic cruise missile
stories.brief: Pakistan successfully test-fired the Fatah-3 supersonic cruise missile, marking another “significant milestone” in the country's efforts to strengthen its defence capabilities, the military's media wing said on Wednesday. Pakistan Army today conducted a successful launch of Fatah-3 Supersonic Cruise Missile, marking another significant milestone in the advancement of national defence capabilities, according to ISPR.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz, Nawaz meet AJK leadership to discuss development projects
stories.brief: According to a statement issued by the Prime Minister's Office (PMO), the meeting focused on development matters in AJK and cooperation between the federal and provincial governments to improve public welfare.

stories.title: China's Xi greets Trump on arrival at Shenzhen airport
stories.brief: Chinese President Xi Jinping personally greeted US President Donald Trump at the airport as the US leader arrived on Wednesday ahead of a trilateral meeting in Shenzhen that will also include Russia’s Vladimir Putin, AFP footage showed.

stories.title: Trump arrives in China ahead of trilateral summit with Xi, Putin
stories.brief: US President Donald Trump was greeted by Chinese President Xi Jinping as he arrived in China.

stories.title: William and Kate honour Earthshot Prize winners in Mumbai
stories.brief: The Prince and Princess of Wales have said environmental innovators are changing the lives of future generations as they celebrated this year's winners of the Earthshot Prize.

stories.title: Bancroft sandpaper claims heap pressure on Cummins
stories.brief: Cameron Bancroft claims the whole Australia team knew about the 2018 sandpaper plot in explosive revelations that will heap pressure on current captain Pat Cummins.

stories.title: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as it reports soaring sales
stories.brief: The AI chip giant reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday after the dramatic exit of Jensen Huang.

stories.title: William and Kate celebrate Earthshot Prize winners in Mumbai
stories.brief: The Prince and Princess of Wales were joined by sporting and acting stars for the annual environmental awards ceremony.

stories.title: How new US chip restrictions on South East Asia will hit China
stories.brief: The new rules restrict chip exports and also access to their computing power, which China relies on heavily.

stories.title: Xi, Trump, Putin exchange first greetings in China ahead of historic meeting
stories.brief: United States President Donald Trump, China’s Xi Jinping and Russia’s Vladimir Putin exchanged first greetings in China on Wednesday, a day before their first formal trilateral meeting. Xi met his Russian counterpart for talks earlier on Wednesday, before Trump arrived in Shenzhen, Chinese and Russian news agencies reported.

stories.title: Gaming phenomenon 'Grand Theft Auto' goes live after 13-year wait
stories.brief: According to the British analytics firm Omdia, sales of “GTA VI” could reach $3.2bn by the end of the year. ‘Taylor Swift of games’ “No other concert or box office release has ever generated that much capital.

stories.title: 'Taylor Swift of games': Grand Theft Auto is back after 13-year wait
stories.brief: Gamers on Wednesday are just hours away from the worldwide release of the latest instalment of "Grand Theft Auto", the most expensive video game ever developed and on track to break sales records.

stories.title: Voyager 1 spacecraft reaches one light-day milestone
stories.brief: NASA's Voyager 1 probe, which has been travelling through space for nearly 50 years, hit a milestone distance of one light-day away from Earth on Wednesday.

stories.title: Australia's Bancroft says 'whole team' knew about 'Sandpapergate'
stories.brief: An "angry and betrayed" Cameron Bancroft said on Wednesday the entire Australia team knew about the 2018 ball-tampering plot that rocked world cricket, directly contradicting current captain Pat Cummins. Bancroft said the release of Khawaja's book and Cummins' new strenuous denials had forced him to speak up.

stories.title: Pakistan, Turkiye explore expanded defence cooperation in advanced military technologies
stories.brief: The meeting focused on translating the longstanding strategic partnership between the two countries into greater operational collaboration, technological cooperation and joint efforts to address emerging challenges in modern air warfare, the statement said.

stories.title: PA speaker urges political parties to debate creation of new provinces
stories.brief: Punjab Assembly Speaker Malik Muhammad Ahmad Khan on Wednesday called on political parties to hold dialogue on the creation of new provinces, saying the constitutional authority to establish them rested with the assemblies but public opinion on the matter could not be ignored.

stories.title: IHC orders medical care for Bushra Bibi in jail amid eyesight concerns
stories.brief: The Islamabad High Court (IHC) on Wednesday directed jail authorities to provide all possible medical facilities to Bushra Bibi, wife of Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) founder Imran Khan, after her lawyer raised concerns that she could lose her eyesight.

stories.title: 'Are your hands clean?': Khawaja Asif hits back at Bilawal over govt criticism
stories.brief: Asif’s remarks came a day after Bilawal delivered a hard-hitting speech at the Karachi Press Club, calling for a “political reset” and criticising the government over its handling of governance and constitutional matters.
